exercises.question: Which sentence uses the future to guess about the present?
options: Estarán en la oficina. [They are probably at the office.]
Estuvieron en la oficina. [They were at the office.]
Están en la oficina. [They are at the office.]

exercises.english: Perhaps we will need more information.
If something unexpected happened, we would look for another solution.

sentences: Los precios podrían subir el próximo año. [Prices could rise next year.]
Nadie puede predecirlo con certeza. [Nobody can predict it with certainty.]
Por eso, conviene prepararse para varios escenarios. [That is why it is wise to prepare for several scenarios.]

exercises.question: Which structure is correct?
options: Si tuviéramos más información, podríamos decidir mejor. [If we had more information, we could decide better.]
Si tendríamos más información, podríamos decidir mejor. [If we had more information, we could decide better.]
Si tengamos más información, podríamos decidir mejor. [If we have (subjunctive) more information, we could decide better.]

exercises.sentence: Según la __ actual, la demanda crecerá.
exercises.english: According to the current trend, demand will grow.
In that situation, a new problem could appear.

exercises.question: Which sentence combines probability and a hypothetical condition?
options: Si subieran los precios, probablemente compraríamos menos. [If prices went up, we would probably buy less.]
Los precios suben y compramos menos. [Prices go up and we buy less.]
Probablemente compraremos menos con estos precios. [We will probably buy less at these prices.]
Perhaps he/she will arrive tomorrow.
He/She definitely arrived yesterday.
He/She cannot arrive.

exercises.sentence: Si cambiara la situación, tendríamos que decidir.
options: If the situation changed, we would have to decide.
If the situation changes, we have to decide.
If the situation had changed, we would decide.

exercises.sentence: Es posible que el resultado sea diferente.
exercises.english: It is possible that the result will be different.

options: Probablemente tendríamos que decidir otra vez. [We would probably have to decide again.]
Probablemente tuvimos que decidir otra vez. [We probably had to decide again.]
Probablemente tengamos que decidir otra vez. [We probably have to (subjunctive) decide again.]

prompt.speaker: A
prompt.text: ¿Qué dice el pronóstico sobre los precios?

options: Según la tendencia actual, los precios subirán. [According to the current trend, prices will rise.]
Según la tendencia actual, los precios suban. [According to the current trend, prices rise (subjunctive).]
Según la tendencia actual, los precios subieron. [According to the current trend, prices rose.]

prompt.speaker: A
prompt.text: ¿Qué harías si el resultado fuera diferente?

options: Pensaría en otro plan. [I would think of another plan.]
Piense en otro plan. [I think (subjunctive) of another plan.]
Pensé en otro plan. [I thought of another plan.]

exercises.question: Which sentence combines a prediction, uncertainty and a hypothetical situation?
options: Si apareciera un problema inesperado, probablemente tendríamos que cambiar el plan. [If an unexpected problem appeared, we would probably have to change the plan.]
El plan nuevo para la empresa ya existe y está disponible en la oficina. [The new plan for the company already exists and is available in the office.]
El problema inesperado ya ocurrió durante la reunión de la semana pasada. [The unexpected problem already happened during last week's meeting.]

template.prompt: Make a prediction and qualify how certain you are.
template.answer: Según la tendencia actual, probablemente habrá cambios, aunque no podemos estar seguros.
Si ocurriera algo inesperado, probablemente tendríamos que cambiar el plan.
